exposure: Time period relative to pregnancy (pre-pregnancy, during pregnancy, puerperium, post-pregnancy)
cohort: The study included 2,158 US women with multiple sclerosis (MS) who had a live birth between 2006 and 2015, identified from commercial health plan data.
finding: MS relapse rates declined during pregnancy, increased during puerperium, and remained at a higher level during the last three postpartum quarters, while DMD treatment significantly decreased during pregnancy and increased postpartum.
